description: Self-hosted YDB topology: storage/database nodes, erasure mode, pdisks, database path.

fields.description: ydbd server series; binaries are fetched through the stroppy gateway.
fields.name: version
fields.title: YDB version

fields.description: config.erasure: none = no redundancy (dev only); block-4-2 = 4 data + 2 parity over >=8 fail domains; mirror-3-dc = 3 realms x 3 domains, >=9 nodes.
fields.name: fault_tolerance
fields.title: Erasure mode

options.label: disk (all pdisks of a host are independent)

fields.description: config.fail_domain_type: which level of host.location the storage layer treats as one failure unit. Upstream uses disk for single-host block-4-2 and rack for mirror-3-dc.
fields.name: failure_domain
fields.title: Fail domain level

fields.description: Nodes running the BlobStorage layer; together with pdisks_per_node they supply the fail domains the erasure mode demands.
fields.name: storage_nodes
fields.title: Storage nodes

fields.description: Nodes running the query/tablet layer of the database; these are what the workload connects to.
fields.name: database_nodes
fields.title: Database nodes

fields.description: Drive entries per host_config; with failure_domain=disk each pdisk is its own fail domain, which is how a small stand reaches 8 or 9 of them.
fields.name: pdisks_per_node
fields.title: PDisks per storage node

fields.description: config.default_disk_type and the drive type of every host_config entry; storage pools are built per device type.
fields.name: disk_type
fields.title: PDisk device type

fields.description: Blob storage groups created in the database's storage pool; more groups spread tablets wider.
fields.name: storage_groups
fields.title: Storage groups

fields.description: Let the recipe size the pdisk files from the machine's free disk instead of a fixed size.
fields.name: auto_size_pdisks
fields.title: Auto-size pdisks

fields.description: Full path of the benchmark database inside the cluster; /Root itself is reserved for the cluster root.
fields.name: database_path
fields.title: Database path

fields.description: Serve the gRPC endpoint over TLS (grpcs://) with a self-signed cluster certificate instead of plain grpc://.
fields.name: grpcs
fields.title: TLS (grpcs)

fields.description: HAProxy instances spreading gRPC clients over the database nodes.
fields.name: haproxy
fields.title: HAProxy nodes

fields.description: How many independent failure units the storage layer actually gets — what the erasure mode is checked against.
fields.name: fail_domains
fields.title: Fail domains

rules.message: block-4-2 needs at least 8 fail domains (storage_nodes x pdisks_per_node when failure_domain=disk)
mirror-3-dc needs at least 9 fail domains across 3 realms
mirror-3-dc spreads hosts over exactly 3 datacenters, so storage_nodes must be a multiple of 3
erasure none still needs one storage node
HAProxy in front of a single database node only adds a hop
